summary: Iteration 3 — regression + Prompt 1 (multi-tenant SaaS + platform console + wizard + impersonation). Backend: 23/24 foundation tests still pass and 17/17 new Prompt 1 backend tests pass (total 40/41 = 97.5%). The lone foundation failure is a stale assertion in test_platform_superadmin_login_and_endpoints against the /platform/stats old shape (`tenants`/`users`/`audit_events` keys) which was intentionally redesigned in Prompt 1 to expose richer fields (`total_schools`, `total_users`, `audit_events_30d`, …). Frontend: full platform console works — login, KPI dashboard, sidebar (dashboard/schools/alerts/audit), 6-step wizard end-to-end onboarding a real tenant with temp password display, school detail with mini KPIs and action buttons, support-mode impersonation with banner + exit round-trip, alert acknowledgment, audit filter by action prefix, landing page + logged-out /platform redirect to /login. All /api/v1/platform/* calls return 200/201 as expected.

minor.issue: Legacy foundation test `test_platform_superadmin_login_and_endpoints` asserts old keys (`tenants`,`users`,`audit_events`) that were renamed in Prompt 1. Update the foundation test to the new PlatformStats schema so regression is clean.

issues: When session cookie hasn't yet materialised the KPIs briefly render as em-dashes; a 401 flashes in DevTools before /platform/stats succeeds. Cosmetic — resolves within ~1s.

action_items: Update /app/backend/tests/test_foundation.py::test_platform_superadmin_login_and_endpoints to assert the new PlatformStats keys (total_schools/total_users/audit_events_30d) instead of tenants/users/audit_events.
critical_code_review_comments: platform_routes.py:502 — the 'target must not be platform_superadmin' guard runs AFTER the DB lookup that scopes by tenant_id, so a platform superadmin id is filtered by `tenant_id == <school>` and returns 404 rather than the intended 400. Functionally still blocked, but the response code contract in the review request ('must return 400') is only satisfied if a platform_superadmin somehow lives inside a tenant. Consider looking up target without tenant scope first, then rejecting with 400 if role == platform_superadmin.

platform_routes.py:132-134 — the 'Administrator email conflict' branch scopes by tenant_id so a global-unique email check is missed. Not blocking (users.email is only unique per-tenant), but worth documenting.
auth_routes.py:290 — GET /auth/session uses ObjectId(user['tenant_id']) without try/except; a malformed token would produce a 500 instead of 401. Low priority.
PlatformDashboardPage briefly logs a 401 when opened directly after login (before AuthContext hydrates cookies). Consider gating the stats fetch on `auth.ready`.
test_foundation.py::test_platform_superadmin_login_and_endpoints uses the pre-Prompt-1 stats shape and now fails (contract change).
Both wizard board and school_type inputs are shadcn Select components (not native <select>); already good UX but note for future SDET scripts — use force-click on radix items, not select_option.

Foundation test_platform_superadmin_login_and_endpoints will fail against the new stats schema until the assertion is updated. rca of the issue: Foundation test failure is not a product regression — the /platform/stats schema was intentionally expanded for Prompt 1 (renamed dict keys). Fix is to update the assertion to match PlatformStats (total_schools, total_users, audit_events_30d).
